summary: Steep residential street with houses within 5-10 m along almost its whole length.

best_section.where: East side, upper end of Frederick Street below the cross road

drivers.seclusion: Houses and apartments line both sides; mapped dwellings at 5 m (at 113 m), 8 m (at 151 m) and 15 m (at 138 m).
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb on both sides, so room to stop exists.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs restrict parking 2P Mon-Fri with resident permits excepted.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of every section
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover over the kerb, with shade from the west side trees; open to the east morning sun.
